data.name: gaming_runtimes_Confirmation

data.name: dotnet_developer_setup_Confirmation

data.name: change_local_password_Description
data.value: Open a visible administrator terminal and securely prompt for a new password for the current local account.

data.name: change_local_password_Confirmation
data.value: A visible administrator terminal will ask for the new password twice. Typed passwords are hidden. This supports local Windows accounts only.

data.name: ctt_winutil_Description
data.value: Download and run the current Chris Titus Tech Windows utility script.

data.name: ctt_winutil_Confirmation
data.value: This downloads and executes a remote script that can change over time. Only continue if you trust christitus.com.

data.name: dism_sfc_chkdsk_Description
data.value: Repair the Windows image and system files, then scan the system drive for filesystem errors.

data.name: dism_sfc_chkdsk_Confirmation
data.value: System repair can take 15–90 minutes. Do not close TweakHub while it is running.

data.name: dism_sfc_chkdsk_CompletionNote
data.value: A restart is recommended after repairs.

data.name: component_cleanup_Description
data.value: Remove superseded Windows component versions to reclaim disk space.

data.name: component_cleanup_Confirmation
data.value: This removes superseded Windows components. Continue?

data.name: network_reset_Description
data.value: Flush DNS and reset Winsock and TCP/IP to repair persistent network problems.

data.name: network_reset_Confirmation
data.value: This can affect static network settings and requires a restart. Continue?

data.name: network_reset_CompletionNote
data.value: Restart Windows before testing the connection.

data.name: windows_update_reset_Description
data.value: Recreate the Windows Update download and catalog caches when updates are stuck.

data.name: windows_update_reset_Confirmation
data.value: This clears cached update downloads and update history shown in Settings. Continue?

data.name: empty_standby_list_Description
data.value: Use Microsoft RAMMap to empty cached standby memory only when diagnosing a measured memory problem.

data.name: empty_standby_list_Confirmation
data.value: Cached RAM is released automatically when applications need it. Emptying it routinely does not improve FPS or PC performance and can make games load more slowly. Continue only for a documented standby-list problem.

data.name: remove_windows_ai_Description
data.value: Disable Windows AI policies and remove available Copilot/CoreAI packages and Recall.

data.name: remove_windows_ai_Confirmation
data.value: This removes packages and disables features. It is partially irreversible and TweakHub cannot guarantee automatic reinstallation. Continue?

data.name: adobe_hosts_block_Confirmation

data.value: Repairs the Store cache and package registration, then verifies that Microsoft Store can launch.

data.name: microsoft_store_repair_Confirmation
data.value: This may reset Microsoft Store cache and package registration. Installed apps and purchases are preserved. Continue?

data.name: gaming_services_repair_Description
data.value: Runs Microsoft's signed Gaming Services Repair Tool, repairs related packages if needed, and verifies the services.

data.name: gaming_services_repair_Confirmation

data.name: print_spooler_repair_Description
data.value: Restarts the Print Spooler, clears stuck print jobs, and verifies the service and queue.

data.name: print_spooler_repair_Confirmation
data.value: This stops printing briefly and removes every pending print job from the local queue. Continue?

data.name: onedrive_repair_Description
data.value: Resets the installed OneDrive client, restarts it, and verifies that its process is running.

data.name: onedrive_repair_Confirmation
data.value: This resets the OneDrive client and restarts synchronization. Your cloud and local files are preserved. Continue?

data.name: wsl_setup_Description

data.name: wsl_setup_Confirmation

data.name: wsl_setup_CompletionNote
data.value: Restart Windows if the result reports that a reboot is required, then open Ubuntu once to finish its first-run setup.

data.name: shader_cache_cleanup_Description
data.value: Deletes the DirectX, AMD, NVIDIA and Intel shader caches of the current user. The driver rebuilds them, so the first launch of each game can stutter briefly. Useful after a driver update or when a game shows graphical glitches.

data.name: shader_cache_cleanup_Confirmation
data.value: Close running games first: files in use are kept. The caches are rebuilt automatically, so the next launch of each game can take longer. Continue?

data.name: driver_backup_Description
data.value: Exports every third-party driver package installed on this PC with pnputil, ready for a clean Windows installation. Portable builds save it in Data\Drivers beside TweakHub; installed builds in Documents\TweakHub\Drivers. The backup can take a few GB.

data.value: This exports all installed third-party drivers to the Drivers folder of TweakHub. Nothing is changed on this PC. Continue?

data.name: driver_backup_CompletionNote
data.value: To reinstall them after a clean installation, run as administrator: pnputil /add-driver "<backup folder>\*.inf" /subdirs /install
